title: 小小英文新鲜事 - 1105 | 科莫多龙宝宝、巨型骷髅、追日小发明
description:
🎧 本期音频为全英文，适合有一定英语基础的小朋友。

👧 今天 Mia 和 Lina 聊了三个新鲜事：

🦎 英国切斯特动物园迎来两只科莫多龙宝宝，世界上最大的蜥蜴！
💀 墨西哥城竖起一座三十三米高的骷髅女士，打破世界纪录！
☀️ 十三岁少年用水和重力造出二十五美元的太阳追踪器！

📖 Word of the day: hatch（孵化）

🎮 谜语时间：我早上起来晚上休息，让影子跳舞、花儿转头看我——我是谁？答案：太阳！

---
🇬🇧 In today's episode:

🦎 Two baby Komodo dragons, the biggest lizards in the world, just hatched at a zoo in England!
💀 A thirty-three-metre-tall skeleton lady stands in Mexico City and breaks a world record!
☀️ A thirteen-year-old boy built a solar tracker with water and gravity for only twenty-five dollars!

📖 Word of the day: hatch

🎮 Riddle time: I rise in the morning and rest at night, I make shadows dance and flowers turn to face me. What am I? Answer: the sun!

📝 生词本 Words to learn

1. hatch（孵化）
to come out of an egg
例：The baby dragons hatched after six months!（小龙宝宝六个月后破壳而出！）

2. lizard（蜥蜴）
an animal with four legs and a long tail that crawls on the ground
例：Komodo dragons are the biggest lizards in the world!（科莫多龙是世界上最大的蜥蜴！）

3. inventor（发明家）
a person who makes something new for the first time
例：Jason is a young inventor!（杰森是一位小小发明家！）

4. tracker（追踪器）
something that follows a thing and keeps up with it
例：The solar tracker follows the sun!（太阳追踪器跟着太阳转！）
